hypotheses: CDK4/6 inhibition by PD-0332991 may produce a histone-mark response most similar to other CDK inhibitors (Dinaciclib, flavopiridol), which show the highest anchor similarity among candidates.
JAK2 inhibition (TG101348) may partially phenocopy the PD-0332991 anchor profile, possibly through shared effects on proliferation-associated chromatin states.
BRAF inhibition (vemurafenib) in the A375 anchor line may yield a histone response resembling PD-0332991 due to lineage-specific signaling context rather than direct CDK4/6 inhibition.
JNK inhibition (SP600125) is a weaker candidate but may share stress-responsive chromatin effects with the query.
